body.x: IT Health (CEO Bae Yoon-sub, www.ithealth.co.kr), an exhibit support company of Daegu Mobile Convergence Center, will participate in ‘2013 International Consumer Electronics Show(hear after ‘CES 2013’) held at US, Las Vegas, from Jan.8, 2013 to Jan.11 and introduce ‘PackStory’ and ‘UrineCare’ equipped with sensor system and smart phone app.

‘PackSrory’ is a shipping black-box system with sensor information storage device that can store information of shipping and smart-phone apps. When the problems, such as deterioration of the goods, re-packaging and the damages, happen, it helps you infer the cause.

‘UrinCare’ is a smartphone-based management system built in urine sensor developed by own technology. It can be useful in homes, nursing homes or hospitals. In case of the elderly who has difficult with handling feces, it can help the elderly by automatically sending guardian or the nurse information.

Since founded in 2007, IT Health has been continued to develop the semiconductor sensor signal, sensor modules and systems. It has got 6 patents and its 8 patents are under screening. And it is preparing for mass production. In addition, in order to retain continued competitiveness, develop dedicated semiconductor and produce sensors, it is under consultation with partners for launching the product in the second half of 2013.

‘CES 2013’ is the world’s largest electronics exhibition hosted by home appliances Manufacturers Association(CEA) whose members are about 600 consumer electronics industry companies of US. In the exhibition, will be introduced all kinds of consumer products such as home network?Mobile?MP3 as well as Audio?Video?Car Audio?Hardware?Software?Satellite receiver?Telephone.

Meanwhile, Daegu Mobile Convergence Center will help 9 domestic mobile IT convergence companies booth lease and facility devices, counseling and interpretation, production shipping, product directory book, as part of national project ‘New Industry Mobile Convergence global competitiveness reinforcement.
